subsection: H. Directors and Officers Liability (D&O) Insurance
text: [See Foster v. Kentucky Housing Corp. (ED KY 1994) 850 F.Supp. 558, 561 (applying Ky. law)—exclusion applicable; compare Conklin Co., Inc. v. National Union Fire Ins. Co. (D MN 1987) 1987 WL 108957 (applying Minn. law)—exclusion not applicable where plaintiff suing in capacity as former employee rather than as discharged officer] (a) [3:692.1] Policy provisions: To address this issue, some policies now specifically provide that “this exclusion shall not apply to a wrongful termination of employment claim brought by a former employee other than a former employee who is or was a Director of the Company.” [See Bernstein v. Genesis Ins. Co. (ND IL 2000) 90 F.Supp.2d 932, 936 (emphasis added) (applying Ill. law); Biltmore Assocs., LLC v. Twin City Fire Ins. Co., supra, 572 F3d at 668—“insured vs. insured exclusion” excepted claims by former officers and directors for wrongful termination, discrimination or sexual harassment] [3:693] Reserved. b. [3:694] “Bodily injury” exclusion: D&O policies typically contain an exclusion for bodily injury.
